_comment: Shared lines. speaker: oracle | narrator | player | system. Character files override any key.
cinematic: HALCYON DYNAMICS. 03:12 UTC. Engineering, finance, and seven years of ledgers, all humming quietly inside the Grid.
Most people see a corporate network. Hunters see a city of light: hosts like towers, traffic like rivers, every process a heartbeat.
At 08:52 an invoice arrived for a finance analyst named Mira Okafor. Overdue. Urgent. Payment on hold.
She clicked Enable Content. Nothing seemed to happen.
VELVET LOCUST: a crew that steals data first and asks for ransom second. They're patient until they have credentials. Then they're fast.
Somewhere inside the Grid, a breach clock has started ticking toward the vault where Halcyon keeps its crown jewels.
The SOC lead, a voice everyone just calls Oracle, has one hunter on call tonight.
oracle_idle: Hypothesis first. Then the query that could prove you wrong.
Filter, then pivot. Every answer is the next question's input.
If you're stuck, press H. Asking costs a little. Guessing costs more.
Contain smart. Ask yourself what they'll do the second they notice you.
Behavior beats indicators. Climb the pyramid.

z0_intro_1.speaker: oracle
z0_intro_1.text: Welcome to the Briefing Room. I'm Oracle. I run the SOC, and tonight I run you.

z0_intro_2.speaker: oracle
z0_intro_2.text: Before we go hunting, you learn the tools. Move with WASD or the arrows, or click where you want to go. Press E next to anything glowing.

z0_intro_3.speaker: oracle
z0_intro_3.text: Come talk to me first. Objectives sit top-left. If you ever get stuck, press H for a hint.

z0_talk_1.speaker: oracle
z0_talk_1.text: Threat hunting isn't waiting for alarms. It's assuming they're already inside and proving where.

z0_talk_2.speaker: oracle
z0_talk_2.text: Study the training rig, open your journal, run your first query, then read the intel wall. The gate opens when you're done.

z0_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z0_outro_o.text: Good. An alert just fired at the mail gateway: invoice-themed phishing. That's VELVET LOCUST's calling card. Go.

z0_outro_p.speaker: player
z0_outro_p.text: On my way to the Inbox Gate.

z1_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z1_intro_o.text: The Inbox Gate. A finance analyst opened an 'overdue invoice' this morning. Headers first. Headers don't lie, but From lines do.

z1_intro_p.speaker: player
z1_intro_p.text: Let's see who really sent it.

z1_intro_o2.speaker: oracle
z1_intro_o2.text: Find every copy, find who received it, and check what the attachment does before you touch anyone's machine.

z1_o3_p.speaker: player
z1_o3_p.text: Two delivered, one quarantined. Mira opened hers.

z1_outro_p.speaker: player
z1_outro_p.text: Phish contained. But Mira enabled content, so something ran on WS-FIN-0142.

z1_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z1_outro_o.text: Then we follow it. The Execution Fields are next: process trees.

z2_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z2_intro_o.text: EDR flagged Mira's workstation. Office spawned a shell. Read the tree: who launched whom?

z2_intro_p.speaker: player
z2_intro_p.text: Parent, child, command line. Let's go.

z2_o2_p.speaker: player
z2_o2_p.text: Word launching PowerShell. That's not how invoices work.

z2_outro_p.speaker: player
z2_outro_p.text: updchk.exe is the second stage. It's calling stat-sync.example.

z2_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z2_outro_o.text: Malware that wants to live survives reboots. Climb the Clockwork Tower and find how.

z3_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z3_intro_o.text: Persistence. Scheduled tasks, Run keys, services: anything that relaunches it at logon. Compare against the baseline.

z3_upgrade.speaker: system
z3_upgrade.text: GEAR UPGRADE: field kit level 10 issued.

z3_outro_p.speaker: player
z3_outro_p.text: Two persistence paths, both removed. And Mira was a local admin. That's how it got SYSTEM.

z3_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z3_outro_o.text: SYSTEM on a workstation means they could read memory. Get to the Shadow Archives. Check LSASS.

z4_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z4_intro_o.text: LSASS holds the keys to the kingdom: password hashes, tickets. Find out who opened it, and how.

z4_intro_p.speaker: player
z4_intro_p.text: Access rights tell the story. Let's read them.

z4_o6_p.speaker: player
z4_o6_p.text: t.brooks. An IT admin's credentials were sitting in that memory.

z4_outro_p.speaker: player
z4_outro_p.text: Credentials reset, LSA Protection on. But they had a head start with t.brooks.

z4_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z4_outro_o.text: Then they've used it to look around. The Recon Maze. Find their map before they use it.

z5_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z5_intro_o.text: Admins run 'net group' every day. The question is never 'what ran' but 'who, from where, and why'.

z5_intro_p.speaker: player
z5_intro_p.text: Context is the signal. Got it.

z5_outro_p.speaker: player
z5_outro_p.text: Five servers answered their sweep. Those are the next stops.

z5_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z5_outro_o.text: Then they're crossing over now. Follow them across the Bridges.

z6_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z6_intro_o.text: Lateral movement. Follow the logons hop by hop, and remember: contain them all at once, or they'll hop again.

z6_intro_p.speaker: player
z6_intro_p.text: Map every bridge, then burn them together.

z6_upgrade.speaker: system
z6_upgrade.text: GEAR UPGRADE: field kit level 20 issued.

z6_o6_p.speaker: player
z6_o6_p.text: Jump server to the vault. They're at the door.

z6_outro_p.speaker: player
z6_outro_p.text: Footholds cut. But the vault still has svchelper, and it's still talking.

z6_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z6_outro_o.text: Climb the Beacon Spire. Find every channel it uses, then cut them in one move.

z7_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z7_intro_o.text: Implants phone home. Look for rhythm: same interval, same size, from places that never browse.

z7_o6_p.speaker: player
z7_o6_p.text: ledger_q3.7z. They're packing the crown jewels.

z7_outro_p.speaker: player
z7_outro_p.text: All channels dead. But how much left before we cut them?

z7_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z7_outro_o.text: This is it. The Core Vault. Scope the theft, stop what's armed, and close it out in the right order.

z8_intro_seer.speaker: seer
z8_intro_seer.text: The ledger is already leaving. You are late, Oracle.

z8_intro_o.speaker: oracle
z8_intro_o.text: The vault. They staged the ledger and armed something on BACKUP-01. The clock is real now. Everything you've learned, all at once.

z8_intro_p.speaker: player
z8_intro_p.text: Preserve, contain, eradicate, recover. Let's finish it.

z8_o4_p.speaker: player
z8_o4_p.text: Ransomware, armed for 13:00. Next to the backups.

z8_flag_p.speaker: player
z8_flag_p.text: Flag captured. The vault is sealed.

z8_outro_o.speaker: oracle
z8_outro_o.text: VELVET LOCUST is out of the Grid. Come to the Debrief. We write it all down so it never happens the same way twice.

seer_tipoff.speaker: seer
seer_tipoff.text: I see the hand you're playing. Rush me, and I move first.

seer_dataloss.speaker: seer
seer_dataloss.text: That record is mine now. You were a step behind.

tipoff.speaker: oracle
tipoff.text: They noticed. Slow down and think about order.

dataloss.speaker: oracle
dataloss.text: We lost data. Breathe. Keep going. The job isn't over.

zone_complete.speaker: oracle
zone_complete.text: Zone secured. The gate is open when you're ready.
